nom: PEACH & LILY Sun Cover Mineral Sunscreen SPF 30

avis.texte: I tried this sunscreen as it had an okay rating on the Yuka app and it was mineral based. I wanted a daily sunscreen that was fairly healthy for my body. It goes on nice but rubs off on my clothes. Because of the tint it makes it look like my grandma's heavy powder brushed on my shirt collar. I also found it will pill even before make up application. Seems to have adequate sun protection though and was gentle on my sensitive skin. Did have some breakouts, but very minor. No white cast. Recommend a try if you know someone who has it but there are others out there that I believe are worth the money more.

loads of people look for the secrets of antiaging. The truth is. Its sunscreen. Out in this florida heat and uv ray. Its a necessary skin routine to have every day. Take off at night with a oil cleanser and then regualr cleanser that works for your skin. I live this sunscreen! And im glad i bought it after i ran out of my regular sunscreen i used!

avis.titre: Good product even with the white cast
avis.texte: Im a medium brown sister who loves lots of sun so a good sun screen for my face was important. Yes, does leave a white cast bit rub it in a bit and it goes away, just have to be patient. Goes well under make up too! Will be re-purchasing.

This never seemed to truly soak into my skin and sometimes pilled. It also made me break out in the more sensitive parts of my face. If you are very fair skinned, the tint may be too orange/yellow for you.

avis.titre: Love this brand but this product is a no
avis.texte: I buy all of my skin care from this brand and was so excited to see this product but I had to return it. It feels like it never settles into the skin and sits very greasy. Immediately broke out my entire face. Regret buying it.

i alwats hate sunscreens because they are either oily, heavy, sit in my pores, give a whitecast, or irritate my skin. this does none of that. i put this on after my moisturizer (matcha pudding from peach and lily). it doesnt feel gross or like i just wasted all my skincare. it is slightly tinted so it kinda feels like a sheer foundation visually, but doesnt physically feel like makeup. its light enough to be barable to re-apply through the day, and the tint coverage stacks when re-applied. i will say it feels expensive. my bottle lasted about 3months. but i was using it sparingly, only about 1-2pea sized amount of the product every application. which most of the time didnt actually feel like enough coverage. but it works so well and feels so nice I know this will be a staple now. even if its expensive 😭

I was using Super Goop unseen sunscreen but wanted to switch to mineral. This is now my new staple. Previously I could feel my face burning even with sunscreen on but now with this product I don't feel any burning at all for hours.

This left my left really dry at the end of the day, I felt a weird thick film on my face. It felt very occlusive in a way and felt like it was just sucking the moisture out of my face. Curious to see how it would work on oily skin types.

Wanted to like this but I think the antioxidants cause an allergic reaction and dries out my skin. I've never reacted to anything before, makeup or skincare. It does pill but be careful. My lips would swell a bit and my cheeks would burn after applying. But I can wear any other sunscreen just fine.
Feels moisturizing going on and holds well! I use this when running as well and have no issues. (I have only worn without makeup). 10/10 will be purchasing again!

skin looks smoothed and hydrated, no pore clogging and no drying. I do need to use something more moisturizing on my eye area but this stuff is the best. Doesn't feel like anything—not heavy, greasy or sticky at all. My skin is very dry, but cheeks get spots from clogged pores very easily. So grateful P&L came through with this fantastic 100% mineral spf.
Feels good on skin. Good ingredients and handy size tube for pocket, backpack or purse. I would buy again.
Easy to blend and feels lightweight It does not irritated my Rosacea which is wonderful

avis.titre: I will definitely be buying this product again
avis.texte: I have very sensitive skin, this product feels great on my skin. I use under my make up for extra protection as outside in the Florida sun a lot.

This SPF is almost perfect for me! I wosh I could give it 4. 5 stars instead of 4. My favourite SPF is no longer available for purchase in Canada, so I had to search for an alternative SPF that is skincare based. I was so excited when Peach and Lily launched this SPF! It is a beautiful formula. It plays well with my skincare underneath as well, and isn't difficult to blend. It does take a couple minutes to fully sink in and to work into my skin. I have a pale complexion and I do not notice a white cast on my face. It leaves my skin feeling soft with a little bit of a glow. My previous favourite brand for SPF left my skin slightly more matte and baby soft, while this leaves my skin more glowy and less matte. That is the only reason for 4 stars - it is really hard to find something that compares to my previous SPF. This is such a close dupe though, that I will continue to purchase it :). I have very dry skin now that I am 40, so the glow might be beneficial for giving a more youthful glow.
I have been using this product for about 3 weeks now. I have no complaints. I apply it and my moisturizer together. No greasy film, absorbs nicely, has not irritated my skin.

Wow! This suncover mineral sunscreen is totally amazing,very nice on my skin and it blends very well,easy to glide on. It is definitely included in my daily skin care. Thanks Peach n Lilly for this wonderful product again! I love it!

This is the first sunscreen I've EVER used that hasn't caused me a week-long rash after use. I've tried many different sensitive/baby mineral (and chemical) sunscreens to no avail.I took a risk on this expensive one since I was gifted other Peach and Lily products that didn't affect my skin, and it has paid off!! I wish there was a waterproof option for when I'm running, but I'll take this win! I haven't properly enjoyed the sun in years.

Unlike most elegantly textured mineral face sunscreens, this does not contain hidden chemical SPF boosters like butocyl salicylate. It also does not contain silicones. It also has a velvety texture, non greasy finish, no orangey tint, and skincare ingredients. My skincare and base make up is entirely silicone free, so I haven't experienced any pilling with this. Silicone, chemical filters, fragrances irritate and break me out (type 2 rosacea) so this clean formula is pretty much my dream sunscreen. Only thing missing is larger sizes!

Very much enjoying this Sunscreen. It goes on very smooth and has good coverage. It doesn't feel cakey or make my hands feel weird after putting in on my face. I've used a couple other mineral tinted sunscreens and this is so far my favorite.
Cannot layer over any skincare without pilling. Pills if you apply makeup over it. The ONLY way to wear this is on freshky washed face. Also rinses right off.

I absolutely love this mineral sunscreen! I'm pretty particular about skincare and usually stick to medical-grade products from my dermatologist or med spa, but I decided to give this one a try—and I'm so glad I did. I have sensitive skin and rosacea, and this formula has been incredibly gentle and non-irritating. I would definitely recommend it to anyone with similar skin concerns. The tint is very subtle, but it makes a noticeable difference—it helps even out my extremely fair complexion and gives my skin a natural, healthy glow.
Tried out the new sunscreen and it felt amazing going on, but very quickly started pilling after application. Gives more of a matte finish than dewey glow.
I've really enjoyed this sunscreen! It works well under my makeup and does well reapplying!

Wow! I was nervous about the mineral vs sheer sunscreen, but saw how clean the ingredients were in the mineral so I had to try it. It feels like I just put lotion on! It's so light and leaves my skin not looking greasy at all. Great product! My only issue was my routine maybe being too much as I broke out when using my c serum, matcha moisturizer and the sunscreen! Every skin is different though.

The sunscreen has no white cast, felt only minimally greasy when first applied (but that does go away), and after a couple of weeks of regular use it hasn't made me break out. My only two issues are that after several hours my skin feels a little dry and tight, but that could probably be fixed by actually reapplying like the directions state (which I forget to do) and that there aren't instructions on how much to use.

I would give this 4. 5 stars if that were an option- it's the best mineral sunscreen I've tried. That said, it is a mineral sunscreen, and my skin doesn't love it. You can definitely tell there's a layer that sits on top of your skin. It looks good though- no white cast.
Looooove this tinted sunscreen! Sinks in so fast and doesn't look like I'm wearing foundation which I like. I've used other tinted SPF's that feel to heavy and this is by far my favorite!
Very light tint. No white cast on my face. Really good sun coverage!
I really love this SPF because its actually 100% mineral and it gives my skin a nice velvety suede finish. Not shiny but luxuriously matte

I have always tried to use sunscreen in my daily skincare. The problem was always the feeling of being greasy and with that the breakouts that would happen. This sunscreen from Peach & Lily sinks into my skin leaving my face feel soft and grease free. I haven't had any breakout since using this. I will repurchase this!
It gives you a feeling that your skin is protected while being hydrated at the same time.

I havent trid this under makeup yet and this is my first day wearing it but I love this so far! I havent felt any stinging and i have very sensitive skin and honestly hate sunscreen. The texture is amazing, i love the ingredients, it went perfectly over my moisturizer and face oil without pilling… as long as this doesnt break me out, this is my favorite sunscreen and ive tried a lot! Surprised at the time of writing this only has 4/5 stars.

Absolutely love this!!! I chose the satin finish version and it leaves the softest, smoothest blurred effect on my skin. Like a great primer but better bc it has SPF!!! Definitely my new go-to sunscreen :hearts:️
This product made me breakout so bad. I also experienced a ton of pilling upon application and it was the only thing on my face. Do NOT recommend.

avis.titre: Decent mineral spf but could be better
avis.texte: Pros: Does not contain silicones or hidden chemical filters (Hard to find mineral spf without these ingredients so this is a major plus). Works well for sensitive skin. Skin doesnt feel dry or greasy but feels nourished after application. Cons: Does leave a slight white cast on dark skin. Requires a lot of rubbing in just to result in slight white cast. Its not matte but also doesnt give any glow. Wish it was spf 50 and also would be nice if it was available in darker shades to prevent the white cast.

This might be my new favorite and I think will make my morning routine faster because it'll replace some products in my line up. This sunscreen is a little like a tinted moisturizer. It goes on smooth, it's a little thick but it blends easily. It has a light color but it just seems to bring out a natural glow. It both has a matte effect and a glow effect. All I have to do is put that on and then a little powder (only because my face is oily) and I look ready to go.

I love everything Peach and Lily puts out, so I wanted to try the sunscreen. I don't wear foundation with it, and it makes my face glow and gives super light coverage. I love that I can see my freckles through it but also smooths out my pores. I will be wearing this all summer long.
I love this sunscreen so much! it's so lightweight and perfect for every day

It's amazing! Not greasy. Plays well with my makeup & other skincare. The person who said they had an allergic reaction must be referring to the chemical formulation of this because avobenzone is not used in mineral formulations.
i have been WAITING on this one, and she's perfect! theres no smell, she sits beautifully on the skin with or without makeup and feels great on the skin. 10/10 buy it!

I used Yes To Grapefruit CC Cream. It was tinted with sunscreen and I was perfect for me. They discontinued it many years ago and I have been looking for a replacement ever since. I think I finally found it with this sunscreen. It absorbs quickly so it didn't leave my face greasy and provides just a little tint to even out my skin tone which is exactly what I was looking for in a daily sunscreen for my face.
